text.tspan: the clients, the hosts, the engine and the model

g.text: HTTP + SSE, serves the web app

text.tspan: each client reaches the same AgentEngine through the host that speaks its protocol. The orchestrator opens one session per fix and reads /v1/prices and /v1/rates, and AskAgent (F5,
F127.3.1) reaches another agent the same way.
